question: Who among the following was sworn in as chief minister of Goa in March 2022?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Pramod Sawant.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Pramod Sawant took oath as the Chief Minister of Goa**, in a ceremony held at the **Dr Shyamaprasad Mukherjee stadium in Taleigao on 28 March 2022.**
 
• Eight other MLAs also took oath as Cabinet Ministers.
 
• Mr Sawant took over the reins after the death of former defense minister and Goa CM Manohar Parrikar in 2019.
 
• Goa Legislative Assembly c**onsists of 40 MLA members.**

**Goa:**

 
• Lok Sabha seats -** 2.**
 
• Rajya Sabha seats -** 1.**
 
• State Animal - Gaur.
 
• State Bird - **Yellow-throated bulbul.**
 
• National Park - **Bhagwan Mahavir (Mollem) National Park.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• ** Manohar Parrikar **was a prominent leader of the BJP and had also served as the Defence Minister of India.
 
• **Digambar Kamat** is a member of the Indian National Congress and has also held the position of Speaker of the Goa Legislative Assembly.
 
• **Sudin Dhavalikar** is a member of the Maharashtrawadi Gomantak Party (MGP) and has also served as the Minister of Public Works Department in the Goa government.
